lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਪੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalake uth papoleeai vin bujhe mugadh ajaan ||
lines.translation: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and without understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਛੁਟੈਗੀ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh chit na aaio chhutaigee bebaan ||
lines.translation: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur setee chit laai sadaa sadaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
lines.translation: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee too(n) aaiaa laahaa lain ||
lines.translation: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੁਫਕੜੇ ਸਭ ਮੁਕਦੀ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lagaa kit kuphakaRe sabh mukadee chalee rain ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਦਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kudam kare pas pa(n)kheeaa disai naahee kaal ||
lines.translation: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: otai saath manukh hai phaathaa maaiaa jaal ||
lines.translation: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਭਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukate seee bhaaleeahi j sachaa naam samaal ||2||
lines.translation: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਘਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ghar chhad gavaavanaa so lagaa man maahi ||
lines.translation: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai jaai tudh varatanaa tis kee chi(n)taa naahi ||
lines.translation: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਥੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਿਕਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: phaathe seee nikale j gur kee pairee paahi ||3||
lines.translation: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee rakh na sakaee doojaa ko na dikhaai ||
lines.translation: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa bhaal kai aai paiaa saranaai ||
lines.translation: I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਇਆ ਕਢਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai paatisaahi dubadaa laiaa kadhaai ||4||3||73||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaRee muhat kaa paahunaa kaaj savaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaam viaapiaa samajhai naahee gaavaar ||
lines.translation: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: uth chaliaa pachhutaaiaa pariaa vas ja(n)daar ||1||
lines.translation: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe too(n) baithaa ka(n)dhee paahi ||
lines.translation: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je hovee poorab likhiaa taa gur kaa bachan kamaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਹ ਡਡੁਰੀ ਪਕੀ ਵਢਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: haree naahee nah daduree pakee vadhanahaar ||
lines.translation: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦਾਤ ਪਹੁਤਿਆ ਲਾਵੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਈਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lai lai daat pahutiaa laave kar taeeaar ||
lines.translation: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਦਾ ਤਾ ਲੁਣਿ ਮਿਣਿਆ ਖੇਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa hoaa hukam kirasaan daa taa lun miniaa khetaar ||2||
lines.translation: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa pahar dha(n)dhai gaiaa doojai bhar soiaa ||
lines.translation: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes in deep sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਇਆ ਚਉਥੈ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teejai jhaakh jhakhaaiaa chauthai bhor bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kad hee chit na aaio jin jeeu pi(n)d deeaa ||3||
lines.translation: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੀਆ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kau vaariaa jeeu keeaa kurabaan ||
lines.translation: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis te sojhee man paee miliaa purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowing Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਡਿਠਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dithaa sadaa naal har a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||4||4||74||
lines.translation: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||4||74||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe galaa visaran iko visar na jaau ||
lines.translation: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa sabh jalaai kai gur naam deeaa sach suaau ||
lines.translation: All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the true object of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸਭੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਇਕਾ ਆਸ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa sabhe laahi kai ikaa aas kamaau ||
lines.translation: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tin agai miliaa thaau ||1||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere karate no saalaahi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, praise the Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਛਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe chhad siaanapaa gur kee pairee paahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bhukh nah viaapaee je sukhadaataa man hoi ||
lines.translation: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਛਿਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kit hee ka(n)m na chhijeeai jaa hiradai sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਥ ਦੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis too(n) rakhahi hath de tis maar na sakai koi ||
lines.translation: No one can kill that one unto whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaataa gur seveeai sabh avagan kadhai dhoi ||2||
lines.translation: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa ma(n)gai sevako laaeeaa(n) apunee sev ||
lines.translation: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.
